trigger: Plays upon entering the lobby base of the Feed Tower.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Feed Spire. Two hundred stories of upward scrolling, automated clickbait, and rage.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: The floor is actively scrolling upward! Stand still and you fall into the void!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Bhai, infinite scroll. Invented for dopamine retention, repurposed to kill us.

lines.speaker: mishthi
lines.text: Oh my god wtf bhai. Vertical format was a mistake. Two hundred floors of reels?

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: Brahmansh climbed this spire alone. Fine, I'll lead the climb. Keep up!
